claims.text: Many reviewers praise these cotton rounds for being soft, absorbent, and not falling apart or leaving lint during use.
Several reviewers find them a great value, especially when bought in bulk packs.
A common complaint is that the pads are too thin, with some saying they feel like paper or toilet paper.
Some reviewers report the pads fall apart or roll up when used with too much rubbing.
A few reviewers mention rough or sharp edges, with one reporting the edge cut their face.
